units.title: Rescue craft release
units.text: The harbor master releases the rescue craft after the pre-launch safety check is complete. No other watch officer may authorize departure.

units.title: Distress beacon logging
units.text: The coast radio operator records distress beacon alerts in the Mariner log. Each entry includes the received time and beacon identifier.

units.title: Mission audio archive
units.text: Mission audio is archived in the Echo locker for 90 days. After that period the recordings are purged unless an investigation hold exists.

units.title: Emergency fuel transfer
units.text: The duty engineer approves an emergency fuel transfer before hoses are connected. The deck lead then records the transferred volume.

units.title: Launch weather feed
units.text: Launch control reads wind and visibility from buoy C7, while tide predictions come from the harbor gauge.
